# Whereig

> > Whereig is a comprehensive geographic reference resource providing location maps, political boundaries, and geographic facts for countries, regions, and administrative divisions worldwide.

The site offers detailed location information for countries across all continents including Asia, Europe, South America, and Africa, with specialized coverage of administrative divisions like provinces, states, counties, and parishes. It features political maps, capitals listings, and geographic data for major nations including India, China, Japan, France, Spain, and many others.

## Key Topics

- Country location maps
- Administrative divisions (provinces, states, counties)
- World geography and political boundaries
- Country capitals and demographic data
- Continental maps (Asia, Europe, South America, North America, Africa)
- Geographic reference data
- Indian states and districts
- South American geography
- European countries
- Pacific Ocean region
- Central America
- Western Asia
- Country facts and profiles
- Regional administrative units
- Geographic coordinates

## World and Continental Maps

- [World Map with Countries - List of Countries of the World, Countries Map](https://www.whereig.com/world-countries.html): Comprehensive world map with all UN member countries listed
- [North America Map | Map of North American Countries, Political Map](https://www.whereig.com/north-america): Political map of North America showing 23 countries and capitals

## Country Location Guides

- [Where is Saudi Arabia? Location Map, Geography & Facts](https://www.whereig.com/saudi-arabia): Saudi Arabia location in Western Asia with geography and facts
- [Where is Ecuador Located? Location Map, Geography & Facts](https://www.whereig.com/where-is-ecuador): Ecuador location in South America with Galapagos Islands and key facts
- [Where is Honduras? / Where is Honduras Located in The World Map](https://www.whereig.com/honduras): Honduras location in Central America bordering Caribbean Sea
- [Where is Georgia Country? Georgia Country Location Map, Geography, Facts](https://www.whereig.com/georgia): Georgia country location map with geography and facts
- [Where is Croatia? Location Map, Geography, County Profile & Facts](https://www.whereig.com/croatia): Croatia location on Adriatic Sea with counties and demographics
- [Where is Guinea Bissau? Where is Guinea-Bissau Located in the World Map](https://www.whereig.com/guinea-bissau): Guinea-Bissau location in Western Africa on world map
- [Where is Suriname? Suriname Location in The World Map](https://www.whereig.com/where-is-suriname): Suriname location in South America bordering French Guiana and Brazil
- [Where is Cyprus? | Where is Cyprus Located in the World Map](https://www.whereig.com/cyprus): Cyprus location and geography on world map
- [Where is Rwanda? | Where is Rwanda Located in the World Map](https://www.whereig.com/rwanda): Rwanda location in Africa on world map

## Administrative Divisions and Provinces

- [List of Ecuador Provinces and Capitals - Provinces in Ecuador](https://www.whereig.com/world-countries-and-capitals/ecuador-provinces-and-capitals-sacc.html): Ecuador provinces including Azuay and Bolívar with capitals
- [Counties of Estonia, List of Estonia counties and Capitals](https://www.whereig.com/world-countries-and-capitals/estonia-counties-and-capitals-eucc.html): Estonia counties list with capitals and population data
- [List of Ethiopia Regional and Capitals](https://www.whereig.com/world-countries-and-capitals/ethiopia-regional-and-capitals-afcc.html): Ethiopia regional states including Addis Ababa and Afar with capitals
- [List of Burkina Faso Regions and Capitals](https://www.whereig.com/world-countries-and-capitals/burkina-faso-regions-and-capitals-afcc.html): Burkina Faso regions with capitals and administrative divisions
- [List of Tajikistan Regions and Capitals](https://www.whereig.com/world-countries-and-capitals/tajikistan-regions-and-capitals-ascc.html): Tajikistan viloyats including Sughd Region with capitals
- [List of Antigua and Barbuda Parishes and Capitals - Parishes in Antigua and Barbuda](https://www.whereig.com/world-countries-and-capitals/antigua-and-barbuda-parishes-and-capitals-nacc.html): Complete list of Antigua and Barbuda parishes with capitals
